_meta.description: Manifest for table_value_check.py. Each entry binds a (label, row_key, col_key) -> expected_pattern. Patterns are Python re.search patterns; use lenient alternations to tolerate minor formatting variation.
_meta.usage: Add entries freely. Patterns should be lenient (e.g. 76\.9?% allows 76% or 76.9%). row_key must match the first cell of a data row after LaTeX stripping. For multi-header tables (tab:llm_bridge), col_key reflects the first (outer) header row cells.
_meta.col_key_note: For resizebox tabular with multicolumn subheaders (tab:llm_bridge), the outer header row is treated as col keys. Use the stripped outer-header cell value (e.g. the model name span) as col_key. Inner sub-headers (1-shot, Delta) are absorbed into row parsing.
